slides.texte_overlay:
Small things that make
women notice you (respectfully)
Have good manners. Hold doors, say thank you, let people go first. Simple courtesy has become rare, and it always gets noticed.
Be good at your passion. Playing guitar at a party, cooking for friends, dancing a little. Real skill is quietly attractive.
Look after your hands and nails. Clean, short and cared for. It's a small detail many people notice right away. Small effort, big signal.
Smile at people, not just at her. A friendly man is relaxing to be around, and people pick up on that warmth. Warmth is magnetic.
Be someone with stories to tell. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it makes me a much better conversation partner.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It makes me a much better conversation partner.

slides.texte_overlay: Stay off your phone in public. A man who is present and looks around stands out in a room full of screens. Look up and be present.
Respect her answer and her space. Friendly, never pushy. Respect is what turns a first impression into a good one. Always.
